run_zeroshot_evaluation: run zero-shot evaluation on datasets like EK100, Charades, EgoTea, or Ego4D MCQ using a LAVILA checkpoint
run_zeroshot_classification: run zero-shot video classification on EK100, Charades, or EgoTea datasets with a LAVILA model checkpoint
run_mir_evaluation: run video-text retrieval evaluation on EK100 MIR dataset computing mAP and nDCG metrics
run_mcq_evaluation: run multiple-choice question evaluation on the Ego4D MCQ dataset using a LAVILA model
run_validate_zeroshot: run zero-shot validation by encoding text labels and video frames then computing cosine similarity logits
